name: Virginia class
note: US Navy nuclear-powered attack submarine (SSN). Very quiet. Armament is 12 Tomahawk VLS tubes plus 4 x 21-inch torpedo tubes (Mk-48, Harpoon); ~25 torpedo-tube weapons. Figures are for Block I-IV (submerged 7,900 t); Block V adds the Virginia Payload Module (submerged 10,200 t, ~40 Tomahawk). Submerged speed and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Astute class
note: Royal Navy nuclear-powered attack submarine (SSN); very quiet. Six 21-inch torpedo tubes firing Spearfish torpedoes and Tomahawk cruise missiles (no dedicated VLS - Tomahawk launched from the torpedo tubes). Nuclear propulsion gives unlimited range; endurance ~90 days limited by food. Crew is not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Yasen-M class
note: Russian Project 885M nuclear-powered guided-missile/attack submarine (SSGN/SSN); quiet. Eight silos of four VLS = 32 cells for Zircon hypersonic, Oniks and Kalibr cruise missiles, plus 10 x 533 mm torpedo tubes. Displacement here is the class (Severodvinsk, Project 885); the upgraded Yasen-M is broadly similar.

source.note: Putin (2019): up to 1,000 km at Mach 9 against sea and land targets; averaged estimates ~400-450 km. Scramjet hypersonic, fired from Yasen VLS.

name: Kilo class (Project 636)
note: Russian Project 636.3 (Improved Kilo II) diesel-electric attack submarine (SSK); exceptionally quiet (the 'black hole') with anechoic tiles. Six 533 mm torpedo tubes with 18 torpedoes; the 636/636.3 also fire 4 Kalibr cruise missiles through the torpedo tubes (no dedicated VLS). Snorkel range 6,000-7,500 nmi. Crew is not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Type 093 (Shang class)
note: PLAN Shang-class nuclear-powered attack submarine (SSN). Six 533 mm torpedo tubes with Yu-series torpedoes and YJ-18 anti-ship missiles. The latest Type 093B (Shang III) adds pump-jet propulsion and a 24-cell VLS, and is classed by the US as a cruise-missile submarine (SSGN); the base Type 093/093A have no VLS. Acoustically noisier than Western SSNs (Victor I-III class).

source.title: YJ-18 | Wikipedia
source.note: US DoD estimate ~540 km; subsonic cruise ~180 km + supersonic sprint ~40 km; 300 kg warhead. Fired from Type 093 torpedo tubes / VLS.
